summary: Netherlands (NL) localization of Business Central 29. It covers Dutch telebanking (payment proposals, payment history, SEPA ISO 20022 export, bank statement import), cash and bank/giro journals, electronic VAT and ICP declarations via Digipoort, CMR notes, the tax authority audit file, Dutch post codes and Intrastat.
overview:
The main Dutch capability is telebanking. Transaction modes, export and import protocols, a Telebank proposal and payment history, and export reports (BTL91, BBV, PAYMUL, SEPA ISO 20022 pain.001 and pain.008 variants) are own objects. They are supported by fields on Bank Account, Customer, Vendor, bank account tables and ledger entries, such as Transaction Mode Code, account holder details and Payments in Process. Bank statements are imported through SEPA CAMT codeunits and processed in the Bank/Giro and Cash journals, which have their own pages and the CBG Posting - Test report. Learn covers this in the telebanking, SEPA, payment scenario and journal pages.

Electronic VAT and ICP declarations use the Elec. Tax Declaration tables, pages and codeunits. Digipoort communication codeunits implement an interface for on-premises and SaaS use, and VAT Statement Line gets an Elec. Tax Decl. Category Code. Other local reports are the CMR notes for sales, return and transfer shipments, the Tax Authority Audit File (XAF) and the VIES declaration. Dutch post code import, Intrastat NL export extensions, G/L entry application fields and VAT number checks (mod 11 and mod 97) complete the layer.

Service documents get NL table and page extensions. Upgrade codeunits create export and import protocols and migrate SEPA and electronic tax declaration data.
key_points: Telebanking: payment and collection proposals, payment history, transaction modes, and docket reports, documented in several Learn scenario pages (domestic LCY, FCY to FCY, LCY to FCY).

SEPA ISO 20022 export reports (pain.001.001.03 and .09, pain.008.001.02 and .08) plus export protocols; Country/Region has a SEPA Allowed field and General Ledger Setup has a Local SEPA Instr. Priority.
Bank statement import with SEPA CAMT pre- and post-mapping codeunits and automatic reconciliation into Bank/Giro journals.
Cash and Bank/Giro journals with own pages, the CBG Posting - Test report, and Cash Journal and Bank Journal source codes.
Electronic VAT and ICP declarations through Digipoort, with VAT category mappings on VAT Statement Line and a response message log.
CMR reports for sales, return and transfer shipments; Tax Authority Audit File (XAF) and Export Financial Data to XML.
G/L Entry gains open, remaining amount and application fields to support applying and unapplying G/L entries; G/L Account has Omit Default Descr. in Jnl.
Dutch post code import and update reports with post code range and update log tables.

areas.what: Adds the Dutch telebanking and bank/giro layer: proposal, payment history, transaction mode and protocol pages, export reports for several bank and SEPA formats, and SEPA CAMT statement import. Bank Account gets account holder, Proposal, Payment History and Creditor Identifier fields. SEPA credit transfer codeunits get an Export procedure and a remittance truncation notification.
areas.why: Learn describes telebanking as electronic payments and collections with banks and statement import with automatic reconciliation.

areas.what: Adds electronic VAT and ICP declaration objects with Digipoort communication, the audit file and financial data export, and cash journal pages. G/L Entry gets open and application fields, VAT Registration No. Format gets mod 11 and mod 97 checks, and General Ledger Setup gets local SEPA and currency fields.
areas.why: Learn explains submission of VAT and ICP declarations to the Dutch tax authorities via Digipoort and the audit file for tax examinations.

areas.what: Adds NL table and page extensions on service headers, contracts, posted documents and archives, plus a service document management codeunit.

Adds Dutch post code management, ranges, update log and import reports. Company Information gets Fiscal Entity No., Country/Region gets SEPA Allowed, and Source Code Setup gets Cash Journal and Bank Journal.
areas.why: Learn describes importing post code files and monthly updates for marketing and relationship management.

areas.what: Vendor, vendor template, purchase header and posted purchase document tables get transaction mode and bank account fields. Vendor Bank Account gets account holder and national bank code fields. Adds the CMR - Return Shipment report.
areas.why: Learn covers CMR notes for return shipments.

areas.what: Customer, customer template, sales header and posted sales document tables get transaction mode and bank account fields. Customer Bank Account gets account holder and Direct Debit Mandate ID fields and procedures to update mandate, IBAN and SWIFT. Adds the CMR - Sales Shipment report.
areas.why: Learn covers CMR notes for sales shipments.

areas.what: Adds Intrastat export management for NL, an Intrastat report subform extension and the CMR - Transfer Shipment report. Intrastat Jnl. Batch gets Export Date and Export Time.
areas.why: Learn covers CMR notes for transfer shipments.

areas.what: Employee gets Transaction Mode Code, bank name and city fields, and Employee Ledger Entry gets the same payment-in-process fields as customer and vendor entries.
The LOCAL and LOCAL READ permission sets are replaced to cover the Dutch objects.
Pre & Post Process XML Import gets a CheckBankAccNo procedure for bank account number checks during import.
Adds the Local Functionality Mgt. codeunit.

issues: Minor: the Learn page on importing bank statements also lists Rabobank protocols (mut.asc, vvmut.asc, ASCII) alongside SEPA CAMT. The narrative names only SEPA CAMT.
Minor: 'migrate SEPA and electronic tax declaration data' is inferred from the upgrade codeunit names (UPG SEPA NL, Elec. Tax. Decl. Upgrade). The input does not say what they do.

Minor: the Learn page on editing document amounts in purchase invoices and credit memos (Check Doc. Total Amounts) is not mentioned. The code summary does not show matching objects, so leaving it out is acceptable.
Minor: the overview says statements are 'processed in the Bank/Giro and Cash journals'. Learn describes statement import into bank or giro journals. The Cash journal link is weaker.
